title: Design Circular Queue
summary: Implement a fixed-capacity FIFO queue whose freed positions can be reused.

contractDetails.constraints: 1 ≤ k ≤ 1000. At most 3000 calls. Values are in [0,1000]. Rows [0,value], [1], [2], [3], [4], [5] call enQueue, deQueue, Front, Rear, isEmpty, isFull. Construct once with k. Serialize every return, encoding booleans as 0 or 1.
contractDetails.output-checking: Construct MyCircularQueue(k) once. Dispatch opcodes 0=enQueue(value), 1=deQueue(), 2=Front(), 3=Rear(), 4=isEmpty(), 5=isFull(). Serialize all returns, with booleans as integer 0/1.

statement: Implement a fixed-capacity FIFO queue whose freed positions can be reused. enQueue(value) appends and reports success, deQueue() removes the oldest value and reports success, Front() and Rear() return endpoint values or −1 if empty, and isEmpty() and isFull() return booleans. Do not use a built-in queue.

examples.explanation: The last insertion reuses a freed slot.
All empty-queue operations have defined results.
The queue can hold zero and be refilled.

constraints: 1 ≤ k ≤ 1000. At most 3000 calls. Values are in [0,1000]. Rows [0,value], [1], [2], [3], [4], [5] call enQueue, deQueue, Front, Rear, isEmpty, isFull. Construct once with k. Serialize every return, encoding booleans as 0 or 1.
hints: Conceptual: An empty position at the beginning can be used again.
Directional: Store a front index and a count in a fixed array.
Implementation: Use modulo capacity for both the write position and the next front position. The count distinguishes full from empty.
complexityAnalysis: O(1) time per operation and O(k) storage.
